# FlareSize

`Flare.Components.FlareSize`

The one size scale every Flare control uses (Xs..Xl; Md is the default unless a component says otherwise). A step names the same height for every full-scale family - button, input, select, avatar, chip, pagination, switch and track - so a row that mixes them never jumps. The height itself is theme-owned: Md and larger meet the WCAG 2.5.8 target minimum of 24x24 CSS px in every built-in theme. Xs is the smallest target a theme's design system defines rather than an invented step below it; where the result is below 24px the spacing exception applies, so use Sm or larger where the minimum has to hold. The 44x44 (iOS) and 48x48 (Android) targets are platform guidance for touch, not a web requirement: use Lg or larger where a finger is the primary input. Components whose value set is not this scale keep their own enum (FabSize, CardSize, DialogSize).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small - dense, for toolbars and inline elements. |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small - compact. |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium - default size. |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large. |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large - prominent. |
